test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A to H are sitting in a row but not necessarily in the same order. E is the fifth from the left and A is the fifth from the right. B and D are adjacent to each other. H is at one end and not a neighbour of D. A is between C and E. There are two persons between E and G. There are three persons between A and D. Who is the third to the left of the person sitting fourth to the right of C?
solution:
Given: A to H are sitting in a row but not necessarily in the same order.

1) E is the fifth from the left and A is the fifth from the right.

2) A is between C and E.

3) There are three persons between A and D.

4) H is at one end and not a neighbour of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da38f8d08f85d39c19f3cee0742c7a5150476660a546b6a348c8c08cb6efca56.png] 

2) B and D are adjacent to each other.

5) There are two persons between E and G.

**Final arrangement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d787505165da085558895dd3fb7451dd32b58b56c23ba7dbb6495934da6c920.png] 

From the both cases:

**A **is the third to the left of the person sitting fourth to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"A".**
